statement: TSMC CoWoS advanced-packaging lead times are reported at 52-78 weeks (both -S and -L variants), with N2/A16 at 78-156 weeks, N3 at 52-78 weeks, and N7 plus mature nodes at 4-17 weeks.
why: Advanced-packaging and leading-edge wafer lead times of a year or more mean accelerator output is set by capacity booked long ago, not by current order intake; no single point figure is stated so no number is asserted.

impact.mechanism: Long upstream lead times cap how fast accelerator supply can respond to demand, holding the binding constraint at packaging and leading-edge wafers.

evidence.excerpt: CoWoS (both -S and -L variants): "52-78 weeks" (page qualifies this as of late 2025).

confidence.basis: Independent analysis site, not a primary foundry disclosure, and the page itself qualifies the CoWoS figure as of late 2025.

dispersion: Stated as a 52-78 week range; comparable ranges given for other nodes.
